description: This file provides Windows-specific terminal handling functions for the Moby project, including console mode management, terminal state saving/restoring, and handling virtual terminal input/output.

classes.name: terminalState
classes.description: Holds the platform-specific console mode state for Windows terminals.

methods.name: stdStreams
methods.description: Initializes standard input, output, and error streams with VT support if possible.

methods.name: getFdInfo
methods.description: Retrieves handle information for a given input interface.

methods.name: getWinsize
methods.description: Returns the size of the terminal window.

methods.name: setWinsize
methods.description: Placeholder for setting terminal window size, not implemented on Windows.

methods.name: isTerminal
methods.description: Checks if a file descriptor is a terminal.

methods.name: restoreTerminal
methods.description: Restores terminal to a previous saved state.

methods.name: saveState
methods.description: Saves the current console mode state.

methods.name: disableEcho
methods.description: Disables echo input on the terminal.

methods.name: setRawTerminal
methods.description: Sets the terminal to raw mode.

methods.name: setRawTerminalOutput
methods.description: Sets the terminal output to raw mode.

methods.name: restoreAtInterrupt
methods.description: Restores terminal state upon receiving an interrupt signal.
